description: This file implements the HostVirtualInput class and its associated EventSink class, handling virtual input events such as mouse, touch, keyboard, rotary, and switch events within the confui namespace, likely for a virtual or emulated environment.

classes.name: HostVirtualInputEventSink
classes.description: A nested class implementing InputConnector::EventSink to handle and forward input events, with additional logic for confirmation UI mode.

methods.name: HostVirtualInput::UserAbortEvent
methods.description: Triggers a user abort event on the host server.

methods.name: HostVirtualInput::IsConfUiActive
methods.description: Checks if the confirmation UI mode is active.

methods.name: HostVirtualInput::CreateSink
methods.description: Creates and returns a new EventSink object for input event handling.

methods.name: HostVirtualInputEventSink::SendMouseMoveEvent
methods.description: Handles sending mouse move events, forwarding to the underlying input.

methods.name: HostVirtualInputEventSink::SendTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles sending touch events, with special handling if confirmation UI mode is active.

methods.name: HostVirtualInputEventSink::SendMultiTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles multi-touch events, with special handling if confirmation UI mode is active.

methods.name: HostVirtualInputEventSink::SendKeyboardEvent
methods.description: Handles sending keyboard events, ignoring them if confirmation UI mode is active.

methods.name: HostVirtualInputEventSink::SendRotaryEvent
methods.description: Handles rotary input events, ignoring them if confirmation UI mode is active.

methods.name: HostVirtualInputEventSink::SendSwitchesEvent
methods.description: Handles switch input events, ignoring them if confirmation UI mode is active.
